title: plan-review review v1
description: Feedback on a markdown plan, written by the neovim-ultraplan plugin on submit.

path.description: Absolute path of the reviewed plan file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the plan text as displayed (lines joined by newline).

note.description: A comment on the whole plan, or null.

comments.description: Anchored comments sorted by lineno. Empty plus a null note means the plan is approved.

end_lineno.description: Last line of the span, equal to lineno for a line comment.

heading.description: The nearest enclosing heading (for a section comment: the section's own heading), or null above the first heading.

text.description: The quoted plan text of the span, capped; null for a section comment.

markdown.description: The whole review rendered as markdown; what the ExitPlanMode hook hands back to Claude.
